Issuing Authority: **NMi Certin B.V., OIML Issuing Authority NL1** 22 August 2019 *[handwritten signature]* C. Oosterman Head Certification Board NMi Certin B.V. Thijsseweg 11 2629 JA Delft The Netherlands T +31 88 6362332 certin@nmi.nl www.nmi.nl This document is issued under the provision that no liability is accepted and that the applicant shall indemnify third-party liability. The notification of NMi Certin B.V. as Issuing Authority can be verified at www.oiml.org OIML Certification System | INSPECTION RvA I 122 --- NMi # OIML Certificate **OIML Member State** The Netherlands Number R76/2006-A-NL1-19.48 Project number 2400355 Page 2 of 2 The conformity was established by the results of tests and examinations provided in the associated OIML Test Reports: For the load cell: - R60/2000-NL1-10.10 dated 20 August 2010 that includes 64 pages (load cells). For the indicator: - DANAK-1919104, dated 28 April 2018, that includes 69 pages (indicator). For each model, the compatibility of load cells and indicator is established by the manufacturer by means of the compatibility of modules form, contained in OIML R76 edition 2006 Annex F.4. **Characteristics of the non-automatic weighing instrument:**
Accuracy class (III) or (IIII)
Maximum capacity 10 t ≤ Max ≤ 120 t
Verification scale interval e ≥ 10 kg
Weighing range(s) Single interval
Maximum number of scale intervals (one weighing range) n ≤ 4000 divisions
Tare T ≤ -Max
Temperature range -10 °C / 40 °C
Power supply voltage 90 – 240 V AC 50/60 Hz
10 – 30 V DC
Software identification        Version number 01.xx
(y, x = 0… 99)
